note: Plain-English route descriptions for Arch-Router-1.5B (spec v0.5.3 difficulty table). Input to the router model is the last user message plus these descriptions (~400 tokens total). Levels: when a request is ambiguous between two levels at 3 or above, choose the higher one.

routes.description: Chat, greetings, acknowledgements, and pure formatting of text the user supplied: bullet lists, tables, capitalization, shortening, translation of a phrase, simple arithmetic or lookups. No tools, no system state, no change to anything. Mentioning a technical word does not make a request harder than level 1.
routes.name: Trivial
routes.typical_choice: Free small model (Groq gpt-oss-20b) or any free model that fits

routes.description: A single-step task with clear instructions and a read-only or purely informational result: summarize a log or email, check a status, ask whether a service or container is running, read a file and report a value, list what exists. Questions about infrastructure ('is docker running?', 'show the backup status') are level 2 even though they name complex systems — the work itself is one lookup.
routes.name: Routine
routes.typical_choice: Free large model (Groq gpt-oss-120b for small prompts, OpenRouter free for big prompts)

routes.description: One bounded change or one bounded diagnosis: restart a container, explain one error, write a short script or function, fix a small bug, roll back one deployment, draft steps for the user to run. The scope is a single component and the result is easy to verify.
routes.name: Moderate
routes.typical_choice: Best free model that fits (prefer quality 4 if free), else cheapest paid

routes.description: Multi-step work that spans components or needs investigation before action: migrate a stack, find a root cause, refactor a module and its tests, analyze a large log set or repository, build a plan with rollback steps, debug a failure whose cause is not yet known. Several dependent steps, code changes, or whole-system reading.
routes.name: Complex
routes.typical_choice: Cheapest quality-4 model (DeepSeek V4 Flash today)

routes.description: Production or security changes, architecture decisions, and anything irreversible or credential-bearing: firewall or access-control changes, rotating keys or credentials, production cutovers, security audits and threat models, secret-handling design. Getting it wrong is expensive or unsafe, so it needs the strongest model and usually human sign-off.
routes.name: Critical
routes.typical_choice: Premium lane if the client policy allows it, else the best quality-4 model

task_classes.description: General conversation, writing, summaries of supplied text, formatting, simple questions.
Servers, containers, VMs, networks, backups, deployment and operations on the homelab / Launch Collective estate (Hermes and OpenClaw's typical work).
Writing, fixing, refactoring or reviewing code, scripts, configs-as-code and tests.
Analysis, comparison, planning, root-cause reasoning, decisions and recommendations.
Work over very large inputs: entire documents, repositories, long logs or transcripts, where fitting and scanning the whole input is the hard part.
